Protocol v57 reconnect is one endpoint-scoped, server-authoritative transaction. The preserved stable slot and cookie survive manifest and asynchronous stage replay; post-load CLC_STAGE_READY is the commit boundary. The targeted ordered snapshot announces and reconciles the exact replicated-prop set, then restores stable-player inventory, stats, movement, characters, scores, cutscene state, applicable cooperative state, and an explicit reconnect commit. Validation remains fail closed and one-shot gameplay commands are not replayed.

Accepted automation through B-1095 is retained: product 8f94b807... / client 33C8FDF8..., verification e94a10d4... / pd-tests DFCE2DFF..., focused 537 assertions in 11 cases, complete 61,337 assertions in 1,161 cases, and native-source guard pass. Earlier rejected runtime receipts remain diagnostic evidence only.

The retained results-20260814T082045Z.json receipt is rejected at 56/93 but proves the B-1095 listener barrier, initial ordinary gameplay, timeout intent and reservation preservation, endpoint-scoped reconnect authentication, manifest acceptance, stage replay, post-load READY, and room reclaim. B-1096 root is now source-confirmed: disconnect death creates a dropped CMP150 through the shared projectile initializer, which populated obj->projectile but omitted the required projectile->obj reverse link. The exact world writer correctly rejected that inconsistent authority graph, while the old compound boundary erased the substage and falsely selected DISCONNECT_FILES.

Current source fixes the shared ownership invariant rather than weakening validation. It also returns typed snapshot status plus client, prop, objective, attempted bytes, and capacity; atomically restores the packet prefix on every failure; logs the first owner; and gives authority-local stage/state write or send failures the retryable timeout close so a valid credential is not consumed as peer content corruption. This source unit is not yet verified.

Required next gates are one source-frozen isolated client/tests build, the focused reconnect contracts, the complete suite, native-source guard, and one ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke proving exact world/inventory commit, resumed authoritative fire, clean exits, and unchanged source. Do not close T-ENGINE-004 from static or component evidence alone. Separate open T-ENGINE work remains ordinary Campaign/player-init, transition reset, broader rollback/lifecycle coverage, and the V-009 visual regression gate; B-1086/V-010 remains the separate white-door repro.

detail.from:
T-ENGINE-004 remains partial. Historical c3746 and the accepted ordinary listen-host, generated-audit, two-cycle Combat Simulator, D-003 rollback, and current two-role authority-first friend-play baselines remain intact. Initiator authority passes 214/214 at results-20260814T020223Z.json and invitee authority passes 218/218 at results-20260814T030245Z.json on the same D1C91583... product binary; the final source/test/tool fingerprint remained 2784d121.... B-1082 through B-1090 are regression gates.

Protocol v57 reconnect is one endpoint-scoped, server-authoritative transaction. The preserved stable slot and cookie survive manifest and asynchronous stage replay; post-load CLC_STAGE_READY is the commit boundary. The targeted ordered snapshot announces and reconciles the exact replicated-prop set, then restores stable-player inventory, stats, movement, characters, scores, cutscene state, applicable cooperative state, and an explicit reconnect commit. Validation remains fail closed and one-shot gameplay commands are not replayed.

Accepted automation through B-1095 is retained: product 8f94b807... / client 33C8FDF8..., verification e94a10d4... / pd-tests DFCE2DFF..., focused 537 assertions in 11 cases, complete 61,337 assertions in 1,161 cases, and native-source guard pass. Earlier rejected runtime receipts remain diagnostic evidence only.

The retained results-20260814T082045Z.json receipt is rejected at 56/93 but proves the B-1095 listener barrier, initial ordinary gameplay, timeout intent and reservation preservation, endpoint-scoped reconnect authentication, manifest acceptance, stage replay, post-load READY, and room reclaim. B-1096 root is now source-confirmed: disconnect death creates a dropped CMP150 through the shared projectile initializer, which populated obj->projectile but omitted the required projectile->obj reverse link. The exact world writer correctly rejected that inconsistent authority graph, while the old compound boundary erased the substage and falsely selected DISCONNECT_FILES.

Current source fixes the shared ownership invariant rather than weakening validation. It also returns typed snapshot status plus client, prop, objective, attempted bytes, and capacity; atomically restores the packet prefix on every failure; logs the first owner; and gives authority-local stage/state write or send failures the retryable timeout close so a valid credential is not consumed as peer content corruption. This source unit is not yet verified.

Required next gates are one source-frozen isolated client/tests build, the focused reconnect contracts, the complete suite, native-source guard, and one ordinary two-client timeout/reconnect smoke proving exact world/inventory commit, resumed authoritative fire, clean exits, and unchanged source. Do not close T-ENGINE-004 from static or component evidence alone. Separate open T-ENGINE work remains ordinary Campaign/player-init, transition reset, broader rollback/lifecycle coverage, and the V-009 visual regression gate; B-1086/V-010 remains the separate white-door repro.

detail.from:
T-ENGINE-004 remains partial for broader Campaign/player-init, transition reset, wider failure rollback, strengthened listen-host lifecycle, and the V-009 release capture gate.

The reconnect slice is production-verified on frozen product 7437d77c... / exact client 0f377e3e.... The sole replacement run publishes the listener, reaches initial NORMAL gameplay, preserves explicit timeout intent plus one reservation and endpoint credential, authenticates one retry, applies the B-1099 prior-stage CUTSCENE 6 -> GE_FADEIN 0 boundary, commits one exact world/inventory transaction, reaches restored NORMAL gameplay, emits five real MagSec shots, records host server_accepted=1, exits both processes cleanly, and leaves no PerfectDark/pd-tests/WerFault process. Existing D-003 smokes were not rerun.

The immutable raw receipt results-20260814T113729Z.json remains rejected at 92/95 because B-1100's old definition required optional LOG.WPN.DIAG output and forbade correct final credential retirement after scripted exit. Verifier-only source now requires bounded COMBAT: SHOT_FIRED and one lifecycle-ordered terminal cleanup. Separately hashed offline revalidation passes the exact retained aggregate/host/client logs 98/98. Rebuilt [b1100] passes 61 assertions in 1 case under verifier 9f6c126b...; product source/client are unchanged. The accepted full 63,936/1,168 and native-source guard were not redundantly rerun.

Committed verified source as b88d7ed665ad80e55cb8d6a2838bd268337ab61a. The commit contains 165 intended files and excludes AGENTS.md, context/pillars/build-dev-tooling.md, docs/CODEX_COORDINATION.md, tools/Workbench/README.md, .codex, and the hook test lane.

2026-08-23 current implementation: candidate-first player/network allocation, exact Campaign body/head source preflight, typed lvReset/playerReset/playerSpawn/playerTickChrBody outcomes, reversible late character-body failures, and one shared fresh/reused transient-default initializer are source-connected. Focused/full/native-source and ordinary Campaign/Combat Simulator transition verification have not yet run; status remains partial.

2026-08-23 final source audit: late chrbody rollback preserves reusable prop spatial/room registration and prior chr ownership; exact integrated catalog bodies alone may retain runtime headnum=-1; Eyespy candidate ownership now explicitly frees model and prop on failed construction. Counter-Op takeover remains outside this ordinary Campaign/Combat Simulator verification unit, so T-ENGINE-004 remains partial.

2026-08-23 verification update: frozen focused/full/native-source automation passes and both ordinary Campaign gates pass. The same retained runtime receipt rejects Combat Simulator at 23/56 after a CPU-live/log-stalled first-cycle hang following exact player spawn, chrbody commit, stats-ready, first-person weapon load, and near-player bot placement. The raw receipt is preserved; diagnosis is active and T-ENGINE-004 remains partial.

2026-08-23 diagnostic root: a clean exact-client rerun reproduced the intermittent CPU spin. Native thread sampling disproves the earlier prop-sort hypothesis and pins all 16 main-thread samples inside modelasmReadFrameData. The decoder compares frame consumption against the animation-header endpoint; once the available chunk resolves to zero, gp remains zero and while (v1 > gp) cannot progress. Current repair scope is an explicit frame-end bound, typed decode failure/fallback, and the separate player-candidate target publication hazard before one rebuilt Combat Simulator acceptance run.

2026-08-23 source repair update, unverified: modelasm frame decoding now owns the animation bytesperframe boundary, validates all header reads/bit reads/skips, emits typed rejection diagnostics, and uses bind pose without entering the legacy unbounded decoder. Private player and Eyespy chrs receive validated explicit target props before publication; generic pre-player construction remains unresolved. Pure/static tests are connected. No post-change build, suite, guard, or runtime pass is claimed yet.

2026-08-24 source closure, unverified: optimized and generic transforms, ANIMFIELD_08 root motion, and camera values use one bounded descriptor/bytesperframe contract. Metadata, conflicting flags, header spans, field widths, payload spans, scratch capacity, and zero-byte semantics reject with typed bind-pose fallback; animnum=0 is a normal bind pose. Luna xhigh's four residual findings are incorporated. Player/Eyespy candidate targets are explicit and stage-arena handles invalidate before release. Next gate is one frozen automation batch, then only the replacement two-cycle Combat Simulator smoke; accepted Campaign, D-003, and reconnect receipts remain retained without rerun.

2026-08-24 B-1101 verification update: the final pure anim_bits.h boundary and explicit-target source pass one isolated source-frozen production/test build, focused 2,007/33, full 64,681/1,181, native-source guard, and zero-mismatch 2,715/401-file product/verifier manifests. Exact client is A0F46D54... and tests B4D51B51.... The sole replacement Combat Simulator smoke remains pending: B-801 refused the first attempt before launch at 1,885 MiB free commit below its 2,048 MiB floor. No game process started and no bypass or runtime acceptance is claimed.

A later read-only B-801 probe found free commit had fallen to 1,604 MiB. Unity PID 70776 held about 13.1 GiB private memory and WizFile PID 9484 about 2.35 GiB; neither was terminated because Unity may contain unsaved work. Runtime verification remains waiting on safe host capacity, not on another source change.

2026-08-24 B-1102 production rejection: host capacity recovered and the exact frozen replacement smoke launched once. It advanced through player publication and chrbody commit, then rejected animation 1 frame 0 and crashed in the fallback at 16/56. Source proof identifies two independent structural defects: schema-v5 special-part reconstruction omitted each required flags byte from the runtime descriptor stream, and rejection nulled animation ownership before calling a CHRINFO consumer that requires it. T-ENGINE-004 remains partial; source is thawed only for one shared producer/consumer layout contract plus an explicit no-animation matrix path. No smoke rerun will occur before one consolidated frozen verification batch.

2026-08-25 B-1102 integrated-audit update, unverified: all four residual edge gaps are source-corrected. Shared stream admission now rejects trailing descriptor bytes; canonical range-checked JSON scalar parsing is production-linked and behavior-tested; zero-frame no-op payloads retain the declared part count; and explicit bind-pose traversal uses a null-safe scale without mutating live animation ownership. One consolidated isolated build/focused/full/native-source batch and one unchanged-source two-cycle Combat Simulator smoke remain.

2026-08-25 B-1102 automation verification: one isolated source-frozen client/updater/tests build and the consolidated focused/full/native-source batch pass on exact product e6287a9c... and verifier ad7c38f9..., with zero manifest mismatches. Focused is 2,057/27 and full is 65,073/1,186. T-ENGINE-004 remains partial until the one unchanged-source two-cycle Combat Simulator production smoke passes; accepted Campaign, D-003, and reconnect receipts remain retained without rerun.

2026-08-25 B-1102 production acceptance: exact client 133A55C6... passes the one authorized clean two-cycle Combat Simulator fixture 56/56. It commits both player-init/match starts, completes the root-stability hold, fires and hits through the real CMP150 path, commits both controlled stats/award matrices, uses Play Again through the Room boundary, reaches both endscreens, exits 0, reports all allocations intact, and leaves no PerfectDark/pd-tests/WerFault process. Product e6287a9c... and verifier ad7c38f9... remain unchanged with zero mismatches and zero animation/crash rejection matches. B-1101/B-1102 are retained regression gates; T-ENGINE-004 remains partial for its broader lifecycle matrix and V-009 remains the visual capture gate.

2026-08-25 B-1103/B-1104 source update, unverified: fully validated CLC_SETTINGS from an exact ready-gate participant now aborts and restores the prepared transaction before settings publication and lobby team re-sanitization. lvReset tracks every successful playerReset commit and reverse-unwinds all committed players on either later reset or spawn failure through canonical Eyespy, chr/model/weapon/fireslot, room/scheduler prop, gunmem, and MP binding owners; chrRemove now explicitly supports model-less reset commits. Luna xhigh owns only the disjoint focused static contract. One consolidated isolated build/focused/full/native-source batch plus failure and positive ordinary co-op/Counter-Op runtime receipts remain; status stays partial.

2026-08-26 B-1104 bounded correction, unverified: the rejected first Counter-Op receipt symbolized the authority crash to modelGetChrRotY after broad NPC enumeration admitted a model-incomplete slot. Current source exports one reciprocal/model-complete readiness predicate to scheduler, count, checksum, writer, and reader paths; bounds u16 NPC counts; verifies emitted rows; rolls shared-buffer and NPC mission-state groups back atomically; clears only successful pending bits; and validates a full receive pass before mutation. Luna xhigh performed the bounded propagation audit and Sol integrated it. One replacement frozen build/focused/full/guard batch and the same four smokes remain; T-ENGINE-004 stays partial.

Release gate for 100 percent proper base-game implementation. Current leaf progress is 3 validated, 7 partial, and 5 missing across 15 explicit dependencies (20 percent production-validated). T-TESTS-002 is validated through the D-005 Agent Profile/campaign matrix. T-ENGINE-004 now retains B-1101/B-1102 bounded-animation and Combat Simulator proof plus B-1067/B-1103/B-1104 protocol-v58 transaction gates. Exact client 5DA75BE6... passes co-op 96/96, Counter-Op 98/98, later-player rollback 60/60, settings rollback 43/43, initiator authority 214/214, reconnect 99/99, and focus-independent invitee authority 170/170. The integrated B-1085/V-009 fixture remains unchanged and rejected at 210/218 only because this desktop exposes no foreground HWND; it is not a D-003 route blocker. T-ENGINE-004 is validated through the durable section 9.10 closure matrix.

V-010 remains not run until every remaining shipped Combat Simulator, campaign/co-op/Counter-Op transition, input/menu, renderer/audio, physics/vehicle, networking, and public-asset path has release evidence and no placeholder, disconnected path, silent fallback, or stale native bypass. B-1086 remains a repro-required Carrington door/material report. B-1105 remains a confirmed public `base:model_skpistol_hi` Mauler activation defect requiring a shared source/cache fix and ordinary equip/fire/render capture. Needler implementation is deferred, but V-009's obstruction/material/effect visual proof remains a regression gate in future gameplay captures.

The next structural implementation unit is B-1105: fix the shared public base:mauler/base:model_skpistol_hi model activation and gun-load lifecycle, propagate across sibling first-person weapon models, and prove ordinary equip/fire/render without fallback or unbounded retry.

2026-08-26 B-1105 root cause is proven before source edits: the public Mauler high-detail MTL declares 13 ordered material slots, including unused slot 11; OBJ use-order creates only 12 runtime slots and collapses declared slot 12 into 11, while the authored render stream correctly indexes slot 12. The shared modeldef importer then rejects that valid index and gun loading retries the permanent activation miss every frame. Current unit will reconcile the complete ordered MTL table before indexed render-stream consumption, audit sibling models, and latch permanent load failure until source/request generation changes; no ROM/native fallback.

2026-08-26 B-1105 source-connected, verification pending: one shared ordered-material planner now retains every declared model.mtl slot, remaps OBJ face materials by name, rejects duplicates/undeclared use, and feeds both readable-cache validation and runtime modeldef construction; model-cache version 10 invalidates collapsed caches. Gun model failures now latch one request until explicit replacement or catalog-generation change, with no ROM/native fallback. Luna xhigh scanned 733 .pdmesh archives and found only base_model_skpistol_hi (plus byte-identical nested Mauler copy) and base_model_cheaddarkaqua as true drifts; 636 other omissions are synthetic pd_default only. Consolidated isolated focused/full/native-source verification and one ordinary nested-path Mauler equip/fire/render smoke with V-009 remain, so V-010 stays missing.

2026-08-26 B-1105 automated material-order/failure-latch verification passes on exact client D9AED555...: focused 47 assertions/6 cases, full 67,023/1,215, native-source guard, and two-archive source verification. The first ordinary-client run rendered and fired a 13-material Mauler but is rejected because extraction restored the removed global duplicate. The strict 732-mesh replacement is retained and rejected at 33/43: the embedded base:mauler dependency registers, gameplay fires nine Mauler shots and exits cleanly, but the compatible pre-existing bundled base:model_skpistol_hi row keeps its legacy provider and filenum 889 reads GskpistolZ.bin. SP-74 now records the structural class. The next bounded source unit is a shared mesh-manifest binder for top-level and nested registration that preserves runtime identity while making the validated typed FileProvider path and source_filenum_symbol authoritative; then one refrozen batch and one replacement smoke remain.

detail.from:
V-010 is the release gate for complete graph-backed base-game implementation. Current leaf progress remains 3 validated, 7 partial, and 5 missing out of 15 (20 percent production-validated); closing a routed defect does not promote an entire leaf. T-ENGINE-004 and T-TESTS-002 remain validated regression matrices.

B-1105/SP-74 is production-verified on exact client 395D48A6.... One generic ordered-material planner preserves the complete model.mtl identity domain; one request-owned latch bounds permanent gun-load failure; and one typed source planner/binder gives top-level and nested .pdmesh ingress the same canonical aliases, identity, provenance, rollback, and later-legacy-pass preservation. Final automation passes focused 132/14, full 67,152/1,223, native-source and two-archive guards, fixture/diff checks, and 23/23 unchanged source hashes. Strict fresh-cache ordinary receipt results-20260826T152922Z.json passes 54/54 with stable gameplay, one nested 13-material compile/activation/Bond-gun/render chain, 11 real Mauler shots, no runtime native/ROM route or endscreen, and clean exit. Four directly reviewed gameplay captures pass V-009 placement, silver/green material, and no-white-obstruction gates. B-1105 and SP-74 are regression gates; earlier binaries and rejected receipts are diagnostic history only.

V-010 remains missing/not_run until every remaining shipped Combat Simulator, Campaign/co-op/Counter-Op, input/menu, renderer/audio, physics/vehicle, networking, and public-asset path has release evidence with no placeholder, disconnected path, silent fallback, or stale native bypass. The next default unit is B-1086: reproduce the reported Carrington Institute solid-white doors, identify the exact public model/material and submitted renderer state, repair the shared boundary if confirmed, and propagate across representative Campaign and Combat Simulator doors. Needler implementation remains post-1.0, while V-009 stays a visual regression gate.
detail.to: V-010 remains the release gate for complete graph-backed base-game implementation at 3 validated, 7 partial, and 5 missing leaves out of 15 (20 percent production-validated). T-ENGINE-004, T-TESTS-002, B-1105/SP-74, and V-009 remain regression matrices. B-1086 is now source-connected but unverified: base:model_instfrontdoor and base:model_cidoor1_ref are both Type-4, but the first carries signed unit normals and the second literal RGBA. The v1 public render stream dropped original G_SET/CLEARGEOMETRYMODE state and the compiler flattened both into an unlit shade path. The typed schema-v2 repair captures exact masks/order, validates and replays them, preserves the node Type combine/cycle, retains legacy v1/custom behavior and the B-936 Type-3 path, and bumps generated model cache v11. The current 1920 diagnostic receipt is not visual closure. One frozen isolated build, consolidated focused/full/native-source batch, fresh extraction proving opposite lighting semantics, and ultrawide Carrington plus Campaign/Combat Simulator visual proof remain. V-010 stays missing/not_run until all release leaves pass.

The current 1920 diagnostic is not visual closure. One frozen isolated build, consolidated focused/full/native-source batch, fresh extraction with exact mixed-state counts, and ultrawide Carrington plus Campaign/Combat Simulator visual proof remain. detail.from: V-010 remains the release gate for complete graph-backed base-game implementation at 3 validated, 7 partial, and 5 missing leaves out of 15 (20 percent production-validated). T-ENGINE-004, T-TESTS-002, B-1105/SP-74, and V-009 remain regression matrices. B-1086 is source-connected and its replacement source/build gates are accepted: schema v2 preserves exact RSP geometry order, per-corner G_VTX known/value state, resolved colour bytes, shared recursive 64-slot ownership, complete face/group ownership, and node Type combine/cycle. Historical schema v1 remains accepted only through its exact named identity. The replacement frozen client/updater/tests build passes; focused 74/74, complete 67,291/67,291, conformance selftest, recursive 27-family examples, modder workflow, native-source guard, and fixture parse all pass with zero drift across 6 product and 20 verifier/migration files. Nine checked-in legacy render leaves are explicitly schema v1 through six containing archives. Fresh schema-v2 extraction with exact mixed-state counts and ultrawide Carrington plus Campaign/Combat Simulator visual proof remain. V-010 stays missing/not_run until all release leaves pass. The first clean production receipt is retained/rejected at 19/26: strict recursive admission was applied before the historical B-798 top-level zero-triangle policy, producing 21 pre-walk extraction failures and blocking five typed asset phases. The owned structural repair will explicitly skip only top-level walks without a real vertex domain while malformed recursive GDL, cycle, bounds, load, and slot paths remain fail-closed; replacement source freeze and runtime proof are pending. The bounded Luna xhigh propagation review found no P0/P1 and confirmed all five top-level call sites retain strict recursive validation. Its two actionable P2 findings are integrated: negative counts reject independently of display-list presence, and current-kind cache reuse requires the complete atomic archive payload rather than four sentinel members. Source remains unverified until the replacement freeze, consolidated automation, 733/733 clean extraction, and visual gates pass.

item.detail: Keep the same Room, creator roles, and shared draft in either option. Stage and validate room geometry, portals, collision, and navigation together before the host applies them. Refusal or timeout keeps the previous world. A distinct world revision prevents stale prediction, placements, and network updates from crossing the transition.

detail.from: Measure cold extraction, warm no-op verification, strict all-family validation, source-hashed cache rebuild, first catalog activation, creator save/pack/import, and representative stage/match load separately. Record host, asset count, cache state, p50/max, failures, and stalls. B-1063 is fixed: private generated caches prefer path-checked $H/mod-cache, admit $S or $B only when the expanded Windows path fits, use one 128-bit filename key, and retain full source SHA-256 in descriptors. The original nested save-root ordinary client passed 24/24 with 594 $H cache references and no $S, $B, or fatal fallback. The broader performance item remains partial until explicit baselines and approved budgets exist. Warm-start changes are in the checkout. Arena/scenario marker validation now reads the complete persisted version record, and the loose ZIP manifest path uses a signature probe. Source guard, Base 9 marker compatibility, and ZIP/JSON source checks passed. Mike authorized a per-run storage exception in D-034. The dirty checkout failed on an unrelated untracked graph static assertion. An exact dev e4deb4404 export with the three owned P-001 paths built client and native tests. Asset source guard, 119 focused cases, and all 2,259 native cases passed. Two same-install warm Base 9 runs per binary averaged 63.16 to 29.84 seconds in asset boot. The arena/scenario phase averaged 34.18 to 1.43 seconds and the walker averaged 25.36 to 25.62. All four runs registered 5,570 assets, rewrote zero archives, and retained 9,026 typed files byte- and timestamp-identical. Ordinary boot passed 14/14. Missing and corrupt CI Training cases each replaced only that archive. A synthetic earlier scenario kind rewrote only 87 scenarios and 47 linked arenas. The broader P-001 cold, validation, creator, and stage budgets remain open. N-0843 retains the pre-change run. November 19 follow-up: parallel loose head/body archive preparation, scoped rollback for existing bundled rows, one-lock full row snapshots, content-verified stage texture migration, and startup-only challenge profile memoization. Clean client and tests builds, 132 focused cases, all 2,262 native cases, 15 release checks, and the asset source guard passed. Base 9 paired warm asset boot took 28.681/45.899 to 17.247/28.320 seconds. A concurrent native build overlapped the second pair. Every run registered 5,570 assets and left 9,026 archive bytes and timestamps intact. Arena and scenario time went from 1,438/1,724 ms to 33/56 ms. Instrumented title smoke passed 16/16. Challenge initialization fell from 14,050 ms to 4 ms (7 lookups), with title initialization observed at 55.95 and 17.71 seconds under different background load. Public head/body admission smoke passed 13/13 and offline Challenge 1 passed 30/30. Missing, truncated, and same-size scenario corruption each replaced one archive. The synthetic scenario kind change regenerated 87 scenarios and 47 linked arenas. The broader timing budgets remain open. November 19 per-archive follow-up: phase 1 reuses one ZIP per archive, verifies the full contents of dirty stage jobs and retains valid public edits during a format update. Phase 2 narrows ordinary bundled-weapon rollback. Exact merged client and tests built, 2523 native cases passed, 16 release checks passed and the source guard passed. Exact worker preserved a valid Extraction edit and mtime. The ordinary-menu background repair and nested weapon smokes are queued. All-family cold/creator/stage budgets remain open.
